name: What is the role of the title company in a remote closing?

mainEntity.name: What is the role of the title company in a remote closing?

acceptedAnswer.text: The title company plays a crucial role in a remote closing, just as it would in a traditional one. Their responsibilities include conducting a thorough title search, issuing title insurance, preparing closing documents like the HUD-1 or Closing Disclosure, and facilitating the secure transfer of funds. In a remote setup, the title company often coordinates the digital signing process or arranges for a mobile notary. Your Kelby Contreras remote closing coordinator works closely with the chosen title company to ensure all title-related aspects are handled efficiently and in compliance with Florida regulations.
acceptedAnswer.description: The title company conducts title searches, issues insurance, prepares closing documents, and facilitates fund transfer, often coordinating digital signings in a remote closing.
